product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 - VCF Automation (Provider Infrastructure APIs)
specification_note: The Apache-2.0 repository https://github.com/vmware/vcf-api-specs publishes one sub-folder per VCF component under specifications/ (fleet-lcm, nsx, sddc-lcm, sddc-manager, vcf-installer, vcf-operations, vsan-data-protection, vsphere). It publishes no VCF Automation specification, so docs/contract.json was transcribed by hand from the rendered Broadcom xAPIs reference pages listed below rather than projected from a machine-readable OpenAPI document.
operation_id_note: The xAPIs reference renders operation titles, not operationIds. The contract identifier 'queryRegions' is this seed's stable handle for the operation titled 'Query Regions' on the page recorded below; it is not a value published by Broadcom.

pages.documents: VCF Automation Provider Infrastructure APIs landing page and Getting Started content: product version; JWT authentication through the Authorization header; the paginated GET /items response convention; list filtering and sorting; the X-VMWARE-VCLOUD-TENANT-CONTEXT header; and Accept-header API versioning, including application/json;version=9.1.0.
Security schemes: ApiKeyAuth, type apiKey, carried in the Authorization request header.
REST API operation index listing Query Regions at GET /cloudapi/v1/regions alongside the other cloudapi/v1 collection operations.

Query Regions operation: GET /cloudapi/v1/regions, the filter / metadata / sortAsc / sortDesc / page / pageSize query parameters with their defaults and bounds, the ApiKeyAuth requirement, and the 200 response.
Regions data structure: the resultTotal, pageCount, page, pageSize, associations and values members of the paginated response body.
Region data structure: id, name, description, nsxManager, supervisors, storagePolicies, status, loadBalancerType and the capacity members, with required and read-only flags.
EntityReference data structure: the optional name and id members used by Region.nsxManager and Region.supervisors.
Error data structure: the required minorErrorCode and message members and the optional stackTrace member returned by failing OpenAPI endpoints.
